# Glossary

The words a story may use for the site's pages and links, and what each is in this suite.

| Words | Is | Get there |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A/B Testing | AbtestPage | `new HomePage().open().click().goToAbtest()`, or `new AbtestPage().open()` (a link on the start page) |
